name: Herdr
provides: See the coding helpers running on this computer and get them moving again: which are working, stuck or done

install.system: Install Herdr from https://herdr.dev, then open it once on this computer

asks: looking at the coding helpers on this computer: it asks once, and a standing answer covers later looks
every change to a coding helper: sending it text or a prompt, naming which one
note: Only the CTO role holds this. Listing and reading the helpers asks once; changing one asks every time, naming which one and the command.
migrationDebt: Raw tool installation/execution and third-party SDK ownership must move to published BYOKit capabilities; this manifest records current behavior, not an approved bypass.
